# CloseTCPServer <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Network](BlitzBasic-Network)

</div>


```blitzbasic
CloseTCPServer:Void tcp_server:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tcp_server` | In | Int32 | required | The server to close. |

## Description

Stops a TCP server. Streams that it accepted stay open.
